scope: Pre-MIA dataset screening only; no membership labels, attack features, IN/OUT distances, ROC-AUC, or attack score may be used.

preprocessing.missing_values: median imputation per feature for profiling only
preprocessing.scale: StandardScaler fit on the complete screened dataset; permitted because this is pre-MIA structural profiling, not release construction

linear_structure.mean_absolute_feature_correlation: upper-triangle mean of absolute Pearson correlation
linear_structure.high_correlation_pair_fraction: upper-triangle fraction with absolute Pearson correlation >= 0.90

local_geometry.knn_distance: Euclidean distance to the kth nearest other sample
local_geometry.knn_distance_cv: standard deviation / mean of kth-neighbour distance
local_geometry.class_density_dispersion: coefficient of variation of per-class mean kth-neighbour distances
local_geometry.local_disagreement: 1 - maximum class proportion among k nearest other samples
local_geometry.knn_label_entropy: label entropy among k nearest other samples, normalized by log(n_classes)
local_geometry.boundary_sample_fraction: fraction with local disagreement at k=10 >= 0.20

geometry_label_conflict.definition: For each k, fraction of points with kth-neighbour distance <= its dataset Q25 and local disagreement >= its dataset Q75, additionally requiring disagreement > 0. If all disagreements are zero, conflict is zero.
geometry_label_conflict.aggregate: retain k=5,10,20 separately; report their unweighted mean only as a descriptive convenience

class_structure.multimodality_proxy: mean across eligible classes of 1 - within-class KMeans(2) inertia / KMeans(1) inertia; classes require >= 2*k samples
class_structure.minority_island_proxy: mean over classes with support <= median class support of fraction whose k=10 same-class neighbour proportion is < 0.50

restrictions: No weighted aggregate structural score is allowed.
No threshold or metric may be changed after real-data MIA begins without creating v2 and a new discovery/confirmation pool.
These measures may rank neither membership outcome nor an inferred privacy score.
